name: CCA 124 疑似起飞鸟击 右发熄火

cards.audioText: B: You are parked on stand D3 and have listened to the ATIS with information P, please ask Beijing Delivery for your ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你停在 D3 机位，已收听 ATIS 信息 P，请向北京放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA 124, stand D3, information P, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA 124，D3 机位，信息 P，请求前往 London 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, is cleared to London via flight planned route, cruising level 10400 meters, initial climb 900 meters on 1023, follow VYK-05D departure, contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，可以按计划航路前往 London，巡航高度 10400 米，初始爬升 900 米按 1023，执行 VYK-05D 离场，联系 120.6，应答机 4523。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, cruising level 10400 meters, initial climb 900 meters on 1023, follow VYK-05D departure, contact 120.6, squawk 4523, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 London，巡航高度 10400 米，初始爬升 900 米按 1023，执行 VYK-05D 离场，联系 120.6，应答机 4523，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready to push back and start up, contact ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在准备推出和开车，联系 ATC。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 124, ready for pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 124，准备推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, push back approved, facing east, start up at your own discretion, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，推出批准，机头朝东，自行决定开车，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing east, start up at own discretion, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出批准，机头朝东，自行决定开车，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, call ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑行，呼叫 ATC。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 124, ready to taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 124，准备滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, taxi via Z6 and F to the holding point Runway 36R, caution work in progress on the intersection of taxiway Z3 and Z6.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，经 Z6 和 F 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，注意滑行道 Z3 和 Z6 交叉口有施工。
cards.referenceText: Roger, taxi via Z6 and F to holding point Runway 36R, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，经 Z6 和 F 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: A ground vehicle crossing taxiway F, suddenly appears in front of you near the intersection of Z3 and Z6, you nearly hit it, inform to controller about this.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 一辆穿越滑行道 F 的地面车辆突然出现在你前方，靠近 Z3 和 Z6 交叉口，你差点撞上，向管制员通报。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 124, a ground vehicle crossing taxiway F, suddenly appears in front of me near the intersection of Z3 and Z6, we nearly hit it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 124，一辆穿越滑行道 F 的地面车辆突然出现在我前方，靠近 Z3 和 Z6 交叉口，我们差点撞上。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 124, yeah, it's an online vehicle, um just been informed that it was an ambulance attending an injured workman, is everything okay with your aircraft?
B: Tell the controller that you applied maximum brake to stop the airplane, but the flight attendant has not given you any injury reports.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 124，是的，那是一辆在线车辆，呃刚获知它是去处理受伤工人的救护车，你的飞机一切正常吗？
B: 告诉管制员你使用最大刹车停住飞机，但乘务员没有给你任何受伤报告。
cards.referenceText: We applied maximum brake to stop the airplane, but there was no injury report, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们使用最大刹车停住飞机，但没有受伤报告，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, continue taxi to the holding point of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，继续滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to the holding point of Runway 36R, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, Ground, contact Beijing on 118.7, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，地面，联系 Beijing 118.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: 118.7, good day, CCA 124.

cards.audioText: B: Contact the Tower and tell them you are approaching the end of your taxi at the holding point, and you are now ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系 塔台，告诉他们你接近滑行终点的等待点，现在准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 124, we are approaching the holding point of Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 124，我们正接近跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, roger, line up and wait.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，收到，进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道等待，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for takeoff, call the Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备起飞，呼叫 塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 124, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 124，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, cleared for takeoff, wind 340 at 7 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，可以起飞，风 340，7 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, continue VYK-05D departure, contact Departure on 120.6, good bye.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，继续 VYK-05D 离场，联系 Departure 120.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Continue VYK-05D departure, contact Departure on 120.6, good bye, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续 VYK-05D 离场，联系 Departure 120.6，再见，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: You fly through a flock of birds, called Beijing Departure and tell them you may have hit a bird during takeoff, the left engine EGT is higher and you want to hold at CDY to carry out a check.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你穿过一群鸟，呼叫 Beijing Departure 并告诉他们你起飞时可能撞鸟，左发 EGT 较高，想在 CDY 等待以进行检查。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CCA 124, we fly through a flock of birds, maybe we hit a bird during takeoff, the left engine EGT is higher, request hold at CDY for check.
cards.referenceTextZh: Beijing Departure，CCA 124，我们穿过一群鸟，起飞时可能撞鸟，左发 EGT 较高，请求在 CDY 等待检查。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, continue climb to 900 meters on QNH 1023, turn right, direct to CDY and hold at CDY at 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，按 QNH 1023 继续爬升到 900 米，右转，直飞 CDY，并在 CDY900 米等待。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters on QNH 1023, turn right direct to CDY and hold at CDY at 900 meters, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1023 爬升到 900 米，右转直飞 CDY，并在 CDY 900 米等待，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller you now have a right engine flame out, and you wish to return to Beijing after the fuel dumping, this is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你现在右发熄火，希望放油后返回 Beijing，这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, CCA 124, right engine flame out, request return to Beijing after dump fuel.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，Beijing Departure，CCA 124，右发熄火，请求放油后返回 Beijing。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, roger PAN, maintain 900 meters on QNH, turn left heading 020 degrees, radar vectors to the dumping area.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，收到 PAN，按 QNH 保持 900 米，左转航向 020 度，雷达引导至放油区。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 900 meters on QNH, turn left heading 020 degrees, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 保持 900 米，左转航向 020 度，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: You have arrived at the dumping area and have finished dumping fuel, inform the controller that you have completed fuel dumping and request radar guidance back to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已到达放油区并完成放油，通知管制员放油完成，请求雷达引导返回 Beijing。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CCA 124, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector back to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Beijing Departure，CCA 124，放油完成，请求雷达引导返回 Beijing。
